empty.title: Nothing downloading
empty.body: Jobs you start will show their progress here.

error.allMirrorsFailed: Every download source failed. Check your connection and try again.
error.verificationFailed: The downloaded file did not match what was expected and was discarded.
error.extractorMissing: The extraction tool is missing from this install. Reinstalling the launcher should fix this.
error.extractionFailed: The downloaded file could not be extracted.
error.diskWrite: The file could not be written to disk. Check your available space and try again.
error.network: A network error interrupted the download.
error.packageUnavailable: The download list does not offer everything this setup needs right now. Try again later.
error.installationNotPlayable: The files were downloaded, but the result was not a usable Quake II installation.
error.packageIncomplete: The download "{{packageId}}" arrived intact but did not contain the game files this setup needs.
error.retailCopyIncomplete: The retail installation was copied, but the copy did not contain the game files this setup needs. Make sure the source installation is still there and try again.
error.missingRuntime: This engine needs the Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x86) installed, and it was not found on this PC. Get it from https://aka.ms/vs/17/release/vc_redist.x86.exe, then try again.
error.bootstrapTargetBlocked: That folder cannot be used for a new installation.
error.retailSourceUnverified: That Quake II installation could not be verified as a retail copy right now. Pick it again from the detected installations, or download the free data instead.
error.gameDataSourceUnusable: That folder could not be used for game data right now. Pick it again, or download the free data instead.
error.engineUpdateUnavailable: This engine has no update available right now.
error.engineNoBackup: There is no previous engine build to roll back to.
error.engineReplaceFailed: The engine files could not be replaced. Make sure nothing is using them and try again.
error.bleedingEdgeUnsupported: Bleeding edge is not available for this engine.
error.bleedingEdgeProbeFailed: Could not check the latest bleeding-edge build. Check your connection and try again.
error.bleedingEdgeSizeMismatch: The bleeding-edge build downloaded did not match what was expected and was discarded.
error.repairNotApplicable: That repair cannot be carried out as a download.
error.unknown: The download failed for an unknown reason.

empty.title: Nothing available to install
empty.body: The download list does not offer an engine right now. Check your connection and try again later.
empty.platformTitle: No engine for this platform yet
empty.platformBody: There's no installable engine for this platform yet. If you already have Quake II installed, add it as an existing installation instead.

r1q2Notice.source: R1Q2 is built from this exact upstream source:
r1q2Notice.license: Licensed under GPL version 3 (including its section 6(d) external-source option). The license text is installed alongside the game files.
r1q2Notice.runtime: Requires the 32-bit Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable (x86), which this installer does not bundle. Get it from Microsoft:

gameData.loading: Checking for installations you already own…
gameData.body: Install with fresh downloads, or copy the game data from a Quake II installation you already own.

freeDownload.title: Download the game data
freeDownload.body: Fetches the free demo data (and, if you enable it below, the point-release extras).

storeCopy.title: Copy from an installation you own
storeCopy.body: Copies pak0.pak and pak1.pak from a detected Steam, GOG or Epic installation. Only the engine is still downloaded.

existingFolder.title: Point at a folder I already have
existingFolder.body: Copies the game data out of any folder you choose. Only the engine is still downloaded.
existingFolder.pickTitle: Choose the folder to copy game data from
existingFolder.retailVerdict: Found retail game data ({{paks}}). This can be copied.
existingFolder.demoVerdict: This folder only has demo-equivalent game data. You can still continue - the installation will be a demo installation.
existingFolder.unusableFallback: This folder does not have usable Quake II game data.

blocked.alreadyInstalled: This folder already contains a Quake II installation. Add it as an existing installation instead.
blocked.unsafePath: This folder cannot be used for a new installation.

programFiles.body: This folder is under Program Files. Windows restricts write access there, which can prevent later updates or config changes without elevation.
programFiles.remedyNote: The picked folder is saved as this installation's write location once you start the install – it does not change the target folder above. If you continue with this folder instead, the same write-access fix stays available afterwards from the installation's own checks.

nonEmpty.body: This folder is not empty. It already contains:

notWritable.body: This folder is not writable. The installation may not be able to save configuration or downloaded updates there.

confirm.includeExtrasHint: Adds the cinematics and extra player skins from the point release. Off by default – most players only want multiplayer.
confirm.includeExtrasDisabledReason: This installation has no videos or player models to copy.

running.gone: This job is no longer active.

retailUpgrade.title: Import retail game data
retailUpgrade.description: Copy pak0.pak and pak1.pak from a Quake II installation you already own. This turns the demo installation into a full installation.
retailUpgrade.loading: Checking for installations you already own…
retailUpgrade.noSources: No store installation was detected. Install Quake II from Steam, GOG or Epic, then try again.

engineUpdate.title: Engine update
engineUpdate.description: Update this installation's engine to the version the launcher currently pins, or roll back to the previous one.
engineUpdate.notFound: This installation could not be found.

bleedingEdge.label: Bleeding edge
bleedingEdge.hint: Track the newest upstream Q2PRO build instead of the launcher's pinned version.

repair.title: Repair installation
repair.description: Fix what a fresh check of this installation finds wrong, one offer at a time.
repair.nothingToRepair: Nothing here can be repaired automatically.
